base_weights: Frozen stagewise rank models trained in 2023; no refit
fit_objective: winner categorical log loss; ties prefer smaller alpha
gate: H2 winner log loss and complete ordered-triple log loss must both not increase; otherwise alpha 0
distribution: (1-alpha) times original joint plus alpha times uniform over distinct ordered triples
decision_policy: Original winner, exact ordered triple and each existing unordered decision preserved for alpha less than one
evaluation_role: Already inspected retrospective, not independent unseen or forward
